title: Automation Tester
description:
* Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts for web and mobile applications.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, smoke, sanity, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Develop automation test scripts using Java and relevant automation frameworks.
* Create and execute test cases based on business and functional requirements.
* Perform API testing using tools such as Postman and Karate.
* Conduct backend and database validation using SQL.
* Perform mobile and device testing using cloud\-based testing platforms.
* Execute cross\-browser testing across Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and other supported browsers.
* Perform performance testing using JMeter.
* Identify, document, track, and manage defects using Jira.
* Work closely with developers, business analysts, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and resolve issues.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, requirement walkthroughs, and release activities.
* Prepare test plans, test cases, test scripts, traceability matrices, and test execution reports.
* Integrate automated testing with CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, Git, and Bitbucket.
* Provide daily test execution status and quality metrics to project stakeholders.
* Support end\-to\-end testing of payment gateways and banking\-related applications where required.

  

**Requirements**  

* 4–6 years of experience in Software Testing and Test Automation.
* Strong experience in functional and automation testing.
* Hands\-on experience with Core Java.
* Experience with BDD\-based test automation frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of XPath and element locators.
* Experience in API testing using Postman and/or Karate.
* Experience in SQL and database testing.
* Knowledge of performance testing using JMeter.
* Experience with web, mobile, and backend testing.
* Knowledge of Jira and TestRail for defect and test management.
* Experience working with Git, Jenkins, and Bitbucket.
* Familiarity with IntelliJ, Eclipse, PyCharm, or similar IDEs.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Experience in cross\-browser and end\-to\-end testing.

title: Automation Tester - Banking
description:
Job Summary


We are looking for an experienced **Automation Tester / QA Automation Engineer** to join our banking technology team. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in **test automation, API testing, web application testing, database validation, and banking/financial services applications**.


You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining automated test frameworks, executing functional and regression testing, identifying defects, and collaborating closely with developers, business analysts, and product teams to ensure high\-quality software delivery.


Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, execute, and maintain **automated test scripts** for banking applications.
* Create and maintain robust **UI and API automation frameworks**.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, system, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Analyze business and technical requirements and prepare **test scenarios, test cases, and test data**.
* Automate repetitive and critical test scenarios to improve test coverage and execution efficiency.
* Perform **API testing** using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or similar.
* Validate backend data using **SQL queries** and database testing techniques.
* Identify, document, track, and manage defects using tools such as **Jira, ALM, or equivalent**.
* Execute automated test suites as part of **CI/CD pipelines**.
* Investigate test failures and perform root\-cause analysis.
* Work closely with developers to troubleshoot and resolve defects.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
* Support **SIT, UAT, regression, and production validation** activities.
* Prepare test execution reports, defect reports, and QA metrics.
* Ensure testing complies with banking quality, security, and regulatory requirements.


Mandatory Technical Skills

* Strong experience in **Selenium WebDriver** or equivalent automation tools.
* Strong programming experience in **Java / Python / C\#**.
* Experience with automation frameworks such as:
* + Selenium
	+ TestNG / JUnit
	+ Cucumber / BDD
	+ Maven / Gradle
* Strong knowledge of **API testing** and REST/SOAP services.
* Experience with **Postman and/or REST Assured**.
* Strong **SQL** skills and experience with database validation.
* Experience with **Git/GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket**.
* Knowledge of **Jenkins or other CI/CD tools**.
* Experience working in **Agile/Scrum** environments.
* Good understanding of SDLC and STLC.


Banking Domain Experience


Experience in one or more of the following banking domains will be highly preferred:

* Core Banking
* Payments
* Cards
* Internet/Mobile Banking
* Loans \& Lending
* Retail / Corporate Banking
* Digital Banking
* Treasury
* Trade Finance
* Wealth Management
* AML / KYC
* SWIFT / ISO 20022
* Domestic and international payment systems


Knowledge of **banking transaction flows, payment processing, reconciliation, settlement, and financial messaging** will be an advantage.


Good to Have

* Experience with **BDD and Cucumber**.
* Experience building automation frameworks from scratch.
* Knowledge of **microservices and distributed systems**.
* Experience testing applications hosted on **AWS/Azure/GCP**.
* Knowledge of Docker/Kubernetes.
* Experience with performance testing tools such as **JMeter**.
* Knowledge of Kafka/event\-driven architecture.
* Experience with **SIT/UAT and production support validation**.
* Knowledge of CI/CD and DevOps practices.
* Experience working with large\-scale banking applications.


Required Soft Skills

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a distributed Agile team.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to understand complex banking business processes.
* Proactive approach to identifying quality and automation improvements.


Education

* Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline**.
* Relevant QA/testing certifications such as **ISTQB** are an advantage.

description:

**Summary**
-----------

title: Adobe AEM QA Engineer
description:

**Experience:** 3–5 Years  
**Job Type:** Full\-time / Contract  
**Location:** Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an **Adobe AEM QA Engineer** with 3–5 years of experience in quality assurance and testing of Adobe Experience Manager\-based applications. The candidate should have hands\-on experience testing AEM websites, components, authoring workflows, integrations, and digital experiences.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform functional and regression testing of **Adobe AEM applications**.
* Create detailed test scenarios, test cases, and test data.
* Test AEM components, templates, pages, dialogs, workflows, and authoring functionality.
* Validate content publishing and authoring workflows.
* Perform cross\-browser and responsive testing.
* Validate integrations between AEM and external systems.
* Identify, document, and track defects through closure.
* Conduct integration, system, regression, and release testing.
* Work closely with AEM developers, business analysts, and product teams.
* Support UAT and production validation activities.
* Participate in defect triage and root\-cause discussions.
* Maintain QA documentation and testing reports.

**Required Skills**

* 3–5 years of software testing experience.
* Hands\-on experience with **Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)**.
* Experience testing AEM websites and digital experiences.
* Knowledge of **AEM authoring and publishing**.
* Experience testing components, templates, workflows, and content.
* Strong understanding of functional and regression testing.
* Experience with defect management tools such as Jira.
* Good understanding of web technologies.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with **AEM 6\.x / AEM as a Cloud Service**.
* Knowledge of **CQ/AEM**.
* API testing experience.
* Selenium or other test automation experience.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodology.

Work Location: In person
